result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk that is currently obstructed by a stopped vehicle. The environment lacks pedestrian signals or refuge islands, and the crossing distance is significant, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Vehicle blocking crosswalk
hazards.description: A white SUV is stopped directly on the marked zebra crossing, forcing pedestrians to walk around it into the path of traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The crossing distance is relatively long without any refuge islands or signalized control to manage traffic flow.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulbouts)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the street at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent vehicles from blocking the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and stopping near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection includes high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure. However, the environment is degraded by sidewalk obstructions and a lack of accessible curb ramps, which compromises safety for all users.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pile of trash and debris blocks the sidewalk on the right, forcing pedestrians to navigate around it.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground sidewalk near the utility pole

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The crossing lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps, making the intersection inaccessible for wheelchair users and those with limited mobility.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the crosswalk at the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and poor pavement quality create a hostile environment for people walking despite the presence of sidewalks.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility devices or strollers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicle signals, which may not provide adequate clearance time or clear right-of-way indication.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and sidewalk area increases trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to organize traffic and use curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with marked zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals, but lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads. The presence of multiple travel lanes and a painted buffer area increases the crossing distance and exposure for pedestrians in a mixed-use environment.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a physical refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signal phases which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
